### Problem to solve

Describe the use case and why existing options do not cover it.

### Proposed behavior

Show the expected behavior with a small example. Explain whether it should be
opt-in or change a default.

### Compatibility

Describe any effect on the native select, existing options, jQuery and Prototype
adapters, keyboard use, or generated markup.

### Alternatives

List workarounds or other approaches you considered.
